prs.title: OAuth credential sync and app integration enhancements

review_comments.body:
missing import - `prisma` is undefined

```suggestion
import prisma from "@calcom/prisma";
```

add this import at the top of the file

mutating the validated response data after parsing violates type safety - if refresh_token is missing, this will cause issues downstream

Consider including refresh_token as optional in the schema instead

timing attack vulnerability - string comparison with !== allows attackers to guess the webhook secret character-by-character

Use a constant-time comparison function instead

empty string fallback bypasses encryption - if CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set, symmetricDecrypt will fail or use an empty key

This should fail fast instead of silently using an empty string

missing error handling - if the fetch fails or returns non-ok status, errors won't be caught

Additionally, missing Content-Type header may cause the endpoint to reject the request
computed property syntax in Zod schemas is invalid and will cause runtime errors - use .passthrough() method instead to allow extra properties
type mismatch - parseRefreshTokenResponse returns SafeParseReturnType but code expects the parsed value directly
missing HTTP method check - endpoint should validate req.method === 'POST' before processing

Passing an empty object may not trigger Prisma's `@updatedAt` decorator since it only updates the timestamp when actual data changes. Consider explicitly setting `updatedAt`:

```suggestion
    await SelectedCalendarRepository.updateManyByCredentialId(this.credential.id, { updatedAt: new Date() });
```
